run_web_docs_texts_only_pipeline: run the script to download a web document dataset from S3, filter to texts only, and sync back
create_texts_only_dataset: create a texts-only version of a web document dataset by removing all columns except texts and general_metadata
sync_s3_dataset_to_local: sync a web document dataset from an S3 bucket to a local scratch directory for processing
remove_dataset_columns: remove unnecessary columns from a HuggingFace dataset keeping only texts and general_metadata columns
save_dataset_to_disk: save a filtered HuggingFace dataset to disk using multiprocessing and sync it back to S3
